fields.name: variant
fields.label: Variant
fields.description: Variant B REQUIRES the cabin categories, inclusions, exclusions, departures, booking steps, policies and operator disclosure below, and must not carry a price. The build refuses a B entry without them.

fields.name: tripTypeTag
fields.label: Trip-type tag
fields.description: "Custom Journey" or "Luxury Train — Fixed Departures".

fields.name: heroImage
fields.label: Hero image
fields.description: Full-bleed, 3:2. This is the page's largest image — a calm composition works best.

fields.name: routeCities
fields.label: Route cities (in order)
fields.description: At least two. City pages link automatically when a name matches.

fields.name: highlights
fields.label: Journey highlights
fields.description: Five to eight. Verb-led: the bold lead ("Cruise") then the rest of the sentence.

fields.name: glanceRows
fields.label: Itinerary at a glance
fields.description: One row per day — the count MUST equal the number of days below, or the build refuses the entry.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Pattern: "Place — Evocative Phrase" (with the em dash).

fields.name: detail
fields.label: Detail
fields.description: Short — e.g. "Drive — 172 km". It wraps, but it should not need to.

fields.name: overnight
fields.label: Overnight line
fields.description: "Overnight in Munnar", or "Departure" on the last day.

fields.name: dayImages
fields.label: Day images (0–4)
fields.description: Up to four. Two render side by side; more become a grid.

fields.name: inclusions
fields.label: Inclusions
fields.description: Required on Variant B, verbatim from the operator.

fields.name: exclusions
fields.label: Exclusions
fields.description: Required on Variant B.

fields.name: departureSeasonLabel
fields.label: Departure season label (Variant B)
fields.description: e.g. "2026–27 season".

fields.name: departureInfo
fields.label: Departures text (Variant B)
fields.description: Stays generic ("Seasonal departures — enquire for current dates") until the schedule question resolves.

fields.name: operatorDisclosure
fields.label: Operator disclosure (Variant B)
fields.description: Rendered in the cabin section header and never buried. Operator tariffs are never published anywhere.

fields.name: bookingTermsUrl
fields.label: Booking terms URL (Variant B)
fields.description: Normally /booking-terms/.

fields.name: practicalNotes
fields.label: Practical notes
fields.description: Icon-led grid. Icons: calendar, plane, clock, pace, passport, currency.

fields.name: related
fields.label: Related journeys (up to 3 slugs)
fields.description: The filename of each journey, e.g. golden-triangle-5n-6d. Leave empty and the section is omitted.

fields.name: pdfFile
fields.label: PDF file path
fields.description: Set by npm run pdf:build — /downloads/<slug>.pdf. Leave as is.

fields.name: priceFrom
fields.label: Price from (INR, optional)
fields.description: Renders only while "Show prices" is on in Site settings. Never on Variant B.

fields.name: metaTitle
fields.label: Meta title
fields.description: At most 70 characters.

fields.name: metaDescription
fields.label: Meta description
fields.description: At most 180 characters.

fields.name: ogImage
fields.label: Social image (optional)
fields.description: Falls back to the hero, then the brand card.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The nine names are locked (CLAUDE.md); edit the words, not the set.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro (two or three sentences)
fields.description: Short on purpose — the journey cards must stay within one scroll. The long version is the body.

fields.name: experiences
fields.label: "What defines it" tiles (3–6, optional)
fields.description: Leave empty and the section is omitted rather than shown with placeholders.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.description: 4:3 tile.

fields.name: practicalNotes
fields.label: Practical notes
fields.description: Icon-led grid. Icons: calendar, plane, clock, pace, passport, currency.

fields.name: faq
fields.label: FAQ
fields.description: Rendered as an accordion with FAQPage schema. At most 8.

fields.name: relatedJourneys
fields.label: Journeys (ordered slugs)
fields.description: The filename of each journey, e.g. kerala-in-a-week-7n-8d, in the order the cards should appear.

fields.description: At most 70 characters.

fields.name: placeholder
fields.label: Placeholder slot (no review yet)
fields.description: A placeholder carries NO name, origin, quote or photo — the build refuses them — and shows "Guest review coming soon".

fields.name: name
fields.label: Guest name
fields.description: Real reviews only.

fields.name: tripLabel
fields.label: Trip label
fields.description: e.g. "Kerala with Houseboat, 11N/12D".

fields.name: photo
fields.label: Guest photo (optional — only with photo consent)

fields.name: consentConfirmed
fields.label: Written consent recorded
fields.description: Must be ON for a real review to publish, and OFF on a placeholder. Never publish a review without recorded consent.

fields.name: _dummyDataFlags
fields.label: Placeholder flags
fields.description: Internal: which fields still hold placeholder values.

fields.name: phoneHref
fields.label: Phone link
fields.description: tel:+91… — digits only after "tel:", and it must match the phone above.

fields.name: gtmContainerId
fields.label: GTM container ID
fields.description: GTM-XXXXXXX. Empty = no analytics loads.

fields.name: metaPixelId
fields.label: Meta Pixel ID
fields.description: Managed inside GTM; digits only.

fields.name: foundingYear
fields.label: Founding year
fields.description: Leave empty until verified — nothing renders a guess.

fields.name: travellerCount
fields.label: Travellers served
fields.description: Leave empty until verified.

fields.name: destinationCount
fields.label: Destinations covered
fields.description: Leave empty until verified.

fields.name: aggregateRating
fields.label: Aggregate rating (1–5)
fields.description: Leave empty until verified.

fields.name: poster
fields.label: Poster image (required)
fields.description: The LCP element — always renders. 16:9, calm composition.

fields.name: videoWebm
fields.label: Hero video — WebM (optional)
fields.description: Upload to the media library first, then paste its path: /uploads/<file>.webm. About 15 MB at most; 1080p ceiling; the poster still renders first.

fields.name: videoMp4
fields.label: Hero video — MP4 (optional)
fields.description: As above: /uploads/<file>.mp4.

fields.name: responseSla
fields.label: Response-time promise
fields.description: Leave empty until you commit to one.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Leave empty and the section renders without a name — never a guess.

fields.name: portrait
fields.label: Portrait (4:5)
fields.description: Leave empty for the neutral placeholder.

fields.name: _dummyDataFlags
fields.label: Placeholder flags
fields.description: Internal inventory of fields still holding placeholder values. Remove an entry when its field holds a real value.
